rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something increases, improves, decreases, or changes considerably.

example.english: This new measure has substantially improved citizens’ quality of life.
example.traditional: 呢個新措施令市民嘅生活質素大大提高咗。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 san1 cou3 si1 ling6 si5 man4 ge3 saang1 wut6 zat1 sou3 daai6 daai6 tai4 gou1 zo2

rows.note: Use this especially with measurable changes such as prices, figures, rates, increases, and decreases.

example.english: Because ingredient costs rose, the restaurant had to substantially raise its prices.
example.traditional: 食材加價，餐廳只好大幅提高價錢。
example.jyutping: sik6 coi4 gaa1 gaa3 caan1 teng1 zi2 hou2 daai6 fuk1 tai4 gou1 gaa3 cin4

rows.note: Use this colloquial comparative construction when something is considerably more or less than before or than something else.

example.english: This year’s rent is substantially more expensive than last year’s.
example.traditional: 今年啲租比舊年貴好多。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 di1 zou1 bei2 gau6 nin2 gwai3 hou2 do1
